title: A narrow stream: /s/ and /z/
goal: Practise /s/ and /z/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Bring your tongue close to the ridge behind your upper teeth without stopping the air. Keep a narrow stream of air. Add voice for z.

articulation.label: sat
articulation.alt: sat: /s/ → /æ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
